correctness.rationale: For categorical K_p x K_q with p,q>=3, adjacency iff row and column both differ, so distance 2 precisely for same row/column pairs. A general-position set is exactly an induced P3-free cluster graph. Its components are exclusively an independent row/column layer, a partial/complete 2x2 rectangle (one or two edge components), or a transversal clique using distinct rows/columns. Counting disjoint types gives Ψ=1+pq z+Σ_{k>=2}(p C(q,k)+q C(p,k))z^k+2R z²+4R z³+R z⁴+Σ_{k>=3}C(p,k)C(q,k)k!z^k, R=C(p,2)C(q,2). The inclusion-maximal polynomial M=p z^q+q z^p+R z⁴+C(max,min)min! z^min follows because only full layers, full rectangles and maximum transversals resist extension. For p>=4, q=2p+4, a_{p+1}=p C(q,p+1), a_{p+2}=p C(q,p+2)>a_{p+1}, but a_p>=p! C(q,p)>a_{p+1}; a sharp strict coefficient valley follows for every p>=4. Empty/singleton and p=q=3 overlap cases were checked, with no double count of edges/rectangles/cliques.
